from html.parser import HTMLParser

class CanonicalExtractor(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.canonical = None
        self.found = False

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if self.found:
            return
        if tag.lower() == 'link':
            attrs_dict = dict(attrs)
            rel = attrs_dict.get('rel', '').lower()
            if 'canonical' in rel.split():
                self.canonical = attrs_dict.get('href')
                self.found = True

def extract_canonical(html):
    """
    Extracts the href of the <link rel="canonical"> tag from an HTML string.
    Returns the href value or None if not found.
    """
    if not html:
        return None
    parser = CanonicalExtractor()
    parser.feed(html)
    return parser.canonical
